rawAnswers.text:
If you mean **the cost of getting dental treatment**—not opening a clinic—prices in Chandigarh Tricity vary a lot by the tooth, materials, and dentist. These are **rough private-clinic estimates**, not a treatment quote:

| Treatment | Approx. cost |
|---|---:|
| Consultation | ₹200–₹1,000 |
| Cleaning/scaling | ₹500–₹3,000 |
| Tooth-coloured filling | ₹500–₹4,000 per tooth |
| Root canal | ₹3,500–₹12,000 per tooth; crown usually extra |
| Crown/cap | roughly ₹2,000–₹18,000, depending on material |
| Single implant | roughly ₹18,000–₹65,000; check whether the crown and other components are included |
| Braces | about ₹17,000–₹1.7 lakh, depending on type and case |

Published ranges aren’t perfectly comparable: an implant quote may cover only the implant, not the abutment, crown, scans, or bone grafting. ([clovedental.in](https://clovedental.in/dentist-near-me/chandigarh?lid=6035&node=16&utm_source=openai))

**Which is worth it?** There isn’t one clear winner for every treatment. For a routine check-up, filling, or cleaning, I’d compare two nearby clinics and choose the dentist who explains the options and gives a written, itemised estimate—not simply the cheapest. For **braces**, look for an orthodontist; for a **root canal**, ask who will perform it and whether the crown is included; for an **implant**, get the implant brand and full restored-tooth price in writing.

Advanced Dental Care Centre in Sector 18-A is one option to compare for implants or cosmetic work because it publishes treatment prices. Clove is another option with published Chandigarh pricing. Those listings help with price-checking, but they don’t establish that either is best for your particular case. ([whatclinic.com](https://www.whatclinic.com/dentists/india/chandigarh/advanced-dental-care-centre?utm_source=openai))

Before agreeing to major work, get a second opinion and ask for the full cost, materials, number of visits, and what happens if complications arise. The most reputable and reliable dental centers across the Tricity include:

### 2. Top Multi-Specialty Private Clinics (Chandigarh)
* **Advanced Dental Care Centre (Sector 18-A, Chandigarh):**

* **Bristles Dental Studios (Chandigarh / Mohali):**
  * **Specialty:** Modern cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign, single-visit root canals, and pediatrics.

* **Tricity Dental Clinic (Sector 44-C, Chandigarh):**

---

### 3. Top Centers in Panchkula
* **Dr. Sanjay Kalra’s Multispeciality Dental Clinic (Sector 5, Panchkula):**
  * **Specialty:** Dental implants, full-arch restorations, and orthodontics.
  * **Why Trust It:** One of the oldest, largest, and most reputable multi-specialty practices in the region. They house specialists from every dental discipline under one roof, making it ideal if your case requires multi-stage treatment.
* **Dr. Dang’s Dental Excellence (Panchkula):**

### 4. Top Centers in Mohali

### How to Make Your Final Choice:
1. **Match the specialist (MDS) to the problem:** For a root canal, verify the doctor is an *Endodontist*; for braces or aligners, an *Orthodontist*; and for implants, a *Periodontist* or *Oral/Maxillofacial Surgeon*.
